race.comment: FULLHEADOFSTEAM (1) has been freshened up since leading then tiring to finish fourth over 1600m at Strathalbyn on 19 August. Wearing blinkers for the first time in what looks a far easier assignment. Expecting a big run. HABONDIA (9) settled midfield and held that position to the line without threatening over 1250m at Morphettville Parks last start. Big drop in grade today and just needs a little luck from the wide gate to be highly competitive. IT'S A SOLID DEEL (3) dropped out quickly last start when stretched to 2000m at Murray Bridge. Can run a better race back at this more suitable journey. Market watch on the debutant ONLY ONE RULER (11) who has finished third at all three trials.
